shared_ancestry_note: Current Clay/FRANK/ClayCode/ClayGraph/UnifiedDB/GWT/Hyperposition/Emergenz artifacts share substantial RAE ancestry. Cross-branch agreement is not independent replication; external literature, direct hosted-model experiments and E2B execution support only their tested mechanisms.

clay.delta: C7 instantiates MOSAIC-G11 as the per-operation runtime identity: semantic, provenance-instance, basis, selection-plan and reader-view axes survive through query, Assembly, workspace, model, effect and re-entry. Add physical fault-domain placement as a separate optimization layer from semantic organs.
clay.next_experiment: Live/twin complete MOSAIC episode with independent basis/plan/view/process-placement mutations and replay.

claycode.delta: MRSC becomes FRANK's reader/compiler organ after MOSAIC/COVE closure. Extend E2B triple-bound projection identity to explicit basis/selection axes and provide packed typed hot-path ABI lowerings; P2/P3 remain separately trained/measured and non-authoritative.
claycode.next_experiment: E2B/Rust property fuzz for SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED plus semantic/instance/basis/selection/view identities and exact reader handoff.

claygraph.delta: ClayGraph is explicitly a specialized associative memory organ within UnifiedDB's logical fabric. Preserve immutable semantic epochs, sparse activation and bounded Assemblies; activation is salience only and exact authoritative fallback remains outside graph truth.
claygraph.next_experiment: Pinned exact/FTS/vector/graph/activation route factorial with truthful/shuffled field, same canonical facts and explicit selection/derivation receipts.

unifieddb.delta: FRANK consumes UnifiedDB as the logical typed persistence/query/transaction planner, not a mandatory single physical DB. Exact event/effect history remains authoritative; graph/vector/FTS/materialized/activation views are derived/rebuildable by default; physical colocation is platform/workload benchmark-gated.
unifieddb.next_experiment: Dedicated four-baseline benchmark: specialized stores, logical federation, shared canonical+sidecars, physical consolidation with replay/p99/write amplification/recovery/common-mode measurements.

gwt.delta: C7 preserves WorkspaceEpisode as a semantic organ even when physically colocated in the cognitive core. UnifiedDB plan, ClayGraph activation/Assembly, candidate set, workspace selection/ignition, MRSC rail/view, model uptake and re-entry remain separately receipted causal stages.
gwt.next_experiment: PLAN x ACTIVATION x WORKSPACE x RAIL/VIEW x REENTRY factorial with identical canonical semantics and ReaderProfile.

hyperposition.delta: H4 firebreaks become runtime placement-independent: semantic class/identity and authority casts survive same-process packed lowering. Add physical fault-domain placement as an independent topology and retain explicit semantic/instance/basis/selection/view comparison axes.
hyperposition.next_experiment: Packed C/Rust handle implementation with cross-class alias/stale-basis/selection/view mutation fuzz plus process-placement variants.

emergenz.delta: C7's tighter runtime must not be treated as emergence evidence. E-CERT2 experiments should store MOSAIC, selection, Workspace, reader-handoff and re-entry receipts so lesions/rescues manipulate one stage while neighboring stages are pinned/randomized.
emergenz.next_experiment: Preregister one recurrent C7 handoff motif and run lesion/mechanistic-rescue/OOD/multiscale analysis with capsule-matched nulls.

frank.delta: Advance OPEN architecture frontier C6 -> C7 CORF. Semantic organs are no longer equated with process/store boundaries. Candidate physical layout: shared cognition core; configurable model runtime; hard-isolated capability/effect broker; sandboxed untrusted tools; asynchronous observability; specialized storage engines behind UnifiedDB.
frank.next_experiment: Linux C7 twin with current runtime control, packed ABI, independent fault injection and exact replay; then Android lowering and full-FT Clay Qwen checkpoint factorial.
